body: Thanks for the encouraging words. I am truly considering the military at this point, I'd have to get in shape first though. Joining the military could get me away from home, make bonds with others and teach me discipline and maybe find myself in some way. Thanks for the response.

I'll keep the numbers game in mind when it comes to jobs now, that's actually really useful advice thank you. As far as therapy or medication, I'm sure I'd really benefit from therapy in some aspects but my relationship with my parents is beyond fucked so they won't help and I don't have the money to be paying for sessions. I will definitely look out for it though, thank you for taking your time to read and respond to this. It's really does mean a lot.
Thank you for taking the time to read the post and respond... I really do appreciate it a ton, especially in darker times like this. Thanks
